newsitem.title: USA: Burlington wins BA Engineering deal.
newsitem.headline: Burlington wins BA Engineering deal.

text.p: Burlington Air Express (BAX) said British Airways PLC Engineering division has awarded Burlington Air Express a new, open-ended contact to handle its logistics and air shipments for aircraft replacement parts.
BAX said in a statement that the "multi-million-dollar" contact covers deliveries from U.S. manufacturing sites to BA in the United Kingdom within 48 hours after pickup.
The U.S. company will provide a returns programme for parts that have to be sent by BA to U.S. vendors or their authorized service centres for repair or refurbishing.
BAX said BA said has more than 2,500 shipments per month forwarded to its engineering facilities. Items range from wash basins to wing tips.
